subject: SF Developer Summit — exhibit logistics & PO routing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: events@devsummit.org
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Booth budget + shipping PO for SF Developer Summit (need routing)

Hi Laura / Aditya,

We committed to a 10x10 exhibit at SF Developer Summit (Sept 16–17). Vendor (Elastic Events) is requesting a refundable deposit to hold the booth space and to schedule crate pickup for shipping — total due now is $8,750 for deposit + $2,400 estimated shipping (west coast). Booth build and lead gen add-ons estimate ~$7,350, so total planned spend for Redwood is $18,500.

Attachments: Budget_Proposal_SFDevSummit_2026.xlsx; Invoice_ExhibitDeposit_ElasticEvents.pdf; Vendor_SOW_RedwoodBooth_v1.docx

Ask: Please confirm approval to proceed and confirm which cost center/PO number template we should use. If possible, can we get an initial PO to cover the vendor deposit and shipping this week so they don’t release the booth?

Notes: we’ll need a separate line for reimbursable staff meals (~$900) and a small shipping contingency. Also want to confirm whether prepaid vendor meals should be run through the PO or reimbursed to the events team.

Thanks — I can open the procurement request if you want me to.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: finance-ops@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth budget + shipping PO for SF Developer Summit (need routing)

Jonas — thanks for the detail and the attachments. Budget looks reasonable.

Pre-approval: Greenwood leadership ok to a spend cap of $19,000 for booth + shipping + contingency, pending PO submission and final vendor SOW. Please route to procurement with the vendor invoice and note cost center 4302-EMKT and project tag EVT-2026-0092.

PO guidance: Procurement should issue a PO that covers the deposit and shipping (two line items) and include a third line for estimated booth build (not to exceed $7,500) to give the team flexibility. Reimbursable meals should be handled as card expenses (Concur) unless the vendor requires prepayment for catering — then put on PO with a note and we’ll reconcile.

Cc’ing finance-ops so they can flag any additional compliance steps for exhibit contracts > $15k. If procurement needs a signature threshold exception for the vendor SOW, loop me in.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth budget + shipping PO for SF Developer Summit (need routing)

Thanks — I’ll create the PO request this afternoon. Action plan: 1) I’ll pull the attached invoice into the procurement system, 2) request cost center 4302-EMKT & project EVT-2026-0092, 3) include vendor SOW and mark deposit + shipping as immediate payment.

Procurement note: please confirm vendor remit-to details in the SOW (Kevin, can you confirm the bank/wire instructions or if they require DocuSign for the SOW?). I’ll add a note to keep booth build line as not-to-exceed $7,500.

HubSpot: I added the event to the HubSpot record under deals/EVT-2026-0092.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
From: Kevin Liu <kevin@elastic-events.com>

Cc: SF Pier Hall Accounting <acct@sfpierhall.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth budget + shipping PO for SF Developer Summit (need routing)

Hi Jonas / Aditya — thanks for confirming. Attached is the vendor invoice for the booth deposit (Invoice_ExhibitDeposit_ElasticEvents.pdf). We can accept PO or wire. Bank details are in the SOW; we generally prefer PO for organizers. If you go PO, please include the vendor address and remit-to as shown.

We do not require DocuSign for the deposit, but the full SOW will need a signed page prior to onsite installation. We can fast-track the SOW signature once the deposit is cleared.

Kevin Liu
Operations Manager — Elastic Events

Quick update: Procurement issued PO #PO-2026-4721 this morning covering: deposit $8,750; shipping $2,400; booth build (NTE) $7,500. PO and vendor remit info attached.

Next steps: 
- Aditya: please send PO to Kevin / Elastic Events and request confirmation of receipt and expected timeline for installation SOW signature.
- Laura: will you approve the Concur expense policy note I drafted for staff meals (card vs PO) so we can publish to the events wiki?
- Finance: once deposit clears, please log event spend under cost center 4302-EMKT and project EVT-2026-0092.

Attachments: PO-2026-4721.pdf (procurement system export) — included in the shared procurement ticket.

Thanks everyone — looks like we secured the space.

— Jonas
